reasons: Documentation-only Work Item with no production code or dependency changes.

executionDecision.reason: The user supplied the Weekly Radar plan and explicitly requested integration into a WI overview; scope, sources, acceptance, and verification are concrete.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record the reviewed documentation boundary before editing and the final evidence state before Finish.

acceptance: The roadmap documents the four archived Work Items as completed and does not represent any future WI as active, shipped, or merged.
The roadmap lists the nine remaining Core Research Pipeline candidates WI-003 through WI-011 with responsibilities, dependencies, and planned status.
The roadmap preserves all fifteen user-supplied Weekly Radar candidates WI-WR-001 through WI-WR-015 with responsibilities and dependency order.

The roadmap records the Weekly Radar purpose, weekly cadence, output priority, no-meaningful-change mode, immutable snapshot sequence, publication layering, failure/retry semantics, system health, secret safety, and no-trading boundary.
The roadmap separates Domain, Application, Reporting/Renderer, Infrastructure/Telegram, Scheduler, and Verification responsibilities; Telegram remains an adapter and does not enter Domain.
README.md reflects the current completed baseline, links the roadmap, and identifies WI-003 as the recommended next governed Work Item without creating it.
The final PR changed-path diff contains only README.md, the roadmap document, and AI Cockpit generated/archive evidence paths; no Cargo, src, tests, CI, credential, or secret-bearing files change.
guidelines: Use Completed, Planned, and Gated labels so evidence-backed status is never confused with a proposed backlog.
Preserve the user-supplied Weekly Radar order and semantics; add only explicit dependency and boundary organization grounded in repository architecture.
Keep the Weekly Radar output as a research radar and never introduce BUY, SELL, price target, position sizing, or capital-action semantics.
Keep Telegram, scheduler, persistence, and secret handling outside Domain; represent them as later Application/Infrastructure/Reporting Work Items.
Do not place credentials, chat IDs, or machine-specific paths in committed documentation or governance evidence.

intent.problem: The repository has completed Foundation, AI Cockpit adoption/configuration, and the first Universe Domain Work Item, while the user-provided Weekly Radar plan is not yet represented as an ordered, evidence-aware Work Item roadmap.
constraints: Integrate the supplied Weekly Radar structure without implementing the future pipeline in this Work Item.
Keep DDD/Clean Architecture boundaries and the explicit no-trading decision boundary.
Distinguish archived completed Work Items from planned and dependency-gated candidates.
Keep Telegram as a delivery adapter and preserve immutable snapshot/retry semantics.
intent.rationale: A single roadmap gives future agents and reviewers one ordered view of the remaining research pipeline and Weekly Radar delivery work while preserving AI Cockpit's one-Work-Item-per-change lifecycle.
